summary: BitVentures Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing unaudited financial results for H1 FY2026 ended December 31, 2025. The filing also describes a share capital restructuring approved at an EGM on December 19, 2025, including termination of the ADS program, a 1-for-20 share consolidation, and substitution listing of ordinary shares on Nasdaq. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation transaction is announced; the event is a routine periodic report of financials and corporate status with no deal terms relevant to special-situations classification.
